scope: Exact enumeration of all unlabelled trees of order 31
resume_policy: A residue is skipped only when both its .summary.done and .exceptions.done files exist; new outputs are written to PID-qualified temporary files and renamed atomically only after the checker emits exactly one RESEARCH_CHECK summary.

uint64_argument.dp_intermediate_bound: Every partial product in the rooted DP is the independence polynomial of a processed induced subforest; its nonnegative coefficient accumulator is bounded by the corresponding binomial coefficient. A and B count disjoint constrained classes, so their sum is also bounded by binom(s,k) for s <= 31.
uint64_argument.hash_note: FNV word multiplication and the sums of per-tree fingerprints intentionally use defined uint64 arithmetic modulo 2^64; they are coverage fingerprints, not mathematical coefficient calculations.
